Table API: duration & distance matrix | Route API: road polylines

XLSX PARSER | OPTIONAL n8n RUNNER AT PORT 5678
xlsx: Fast in-memory parsing of commuter spreadsheets via Multer
n8n Webhook: Optional scheduled batch runner calling /api/whatsapp/send
Verified end-to-end operational lifecycle: from daily status submission to approval, late isolation, and regeneration
Commuters toggle travelStatus ('Coming' / 'Not Coming') via Student Dashboard before the operational cutoff window.
Updates User.travelStatus; resets old bus allocation.
System filters active students where travelStatus == 'Coming'. Non-traveling and pending students are safely excluded.
Stops are resolved, geocoded, and aggregated into demand clusters.
Executes OSRM road matrix lookup, Clarke-Wright savings, and 2-opt untangling. Generates draft plan proposal in memory.
Zero live database assignments modified during preview mode.
Admin inspects proposed routes, stop sequences, vehicle utilization, and manifests in Plan Confirmation. Approves proposal.
Atomic database transaction sets User.assignedBus, generates boarding manifests, and writes telemetry to RoutePerformance.
AiPlan marked active; institutional fleet schedule goes live.
Student Dashboard immediately reflects allocated bus number, designated stop, and schedule. WhatsApp alerts dispatched.
Commuters receive real-time bus number & boarding timetable.
If student submits 'Coming' after plan approval, student is NOT injected into running route. Quarantined in LateResponseEvent.
Admin inspects late queue. Triggers AI regeneration which checks vehicle spare seats, proposes revised plan, and admin re-approves.
Allows independent resetting of INWARD (morning pickup) or OUTWARD (evening drop) routes without wiping the counter direction.
Ensures operational flexibility across independent daily shifts.
Document collections, TTL caching, operational event stores, and telemetry models
assignedBus, stopName, and E.164 phone number
Morning pickup shifts & evening return departure times
Active timetable flags & academic calendar links
Assigned vehicles, passenger manifests & road polylines
Student ID, plan approval ID, response timestamp
Stores road distances & durations between coordinate pairs
Automatic TTL expiration (14 days) eliminates re-queries
In-memory LRU map handles hot repeat queries
InwardStartingPlace: Starting depot lat/lon per bus
RoutePerformance: Planned vs actual mileage & fill ratio
All inter-service calls use typed payloads, structured error boundaries, and explicit transaction locks during live plan activation.
• Runtime Engine: Production runs in DETERMINISTIC_HEURISTIC_OPTIMIZER mode (Clarke-Wright, 2-Opt & Co-occurrence).
• Machine Learning: Standalone Python training pipeline (train_model.py) exists offline; runtime operates on verified heuristics.
• WhatsApp: Direct embedded Baileys WebSocket socket active natively; optional n8n webhook configured for scheduled reminders.
